TechnologyStack.Runtime: Local shell workspace on macOS-like environment
TechnologyStack.CompatibilityMode: GRACE (Graph-RAG Anchored Code Engineering) planning shim for a VIBE-core repository.

dep.name: python3
dep.purpose: XML and TOML parsing, lightweight verification commands, and repository-local automation.

dep.name: git
dep.purpose: Version control, review checkpoints, and future commit boundaries.

dep.name: ripgrep
dep.purpose: Fast repository search during planning and execution.

constraint.reason: Current verification commands rely on Python parsing and optional tomli fallback for TOML support.

module-level.command: python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('docs/requirements.xml'); ET.parse('docs/development-plan.xml'); ET.parse('docs/verification-plan.xml'); ET.parse('docs/knowledge-graph.xml'); ET.parse('docs/decisions.xml'); ET.parse('docs/technology.xml')"
module-level.focus: Fast deterministic parsing and structural integrity checks for canonical planning artifacts.

wave-level.command: python3 -c "import importlib.util; mod='tomllib' if importlib.util.find_spec('tomllib') else 'tomli'; t=__import__(mod); t.load(open('vibe.toml','rb')); t.load(open('docs/vibe/governance.toml','rb')); t.load(open('docs/vibe/macros.toml','rb'))"
wave-level.focus: Shared configuration coherence after cross-artifact planning changes.

phase-level.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; required=['docs/requirements.xml','docs/development-plan.xml','docs/verification-plan.xml','docs/knowledge-graph.xml','docs/decisions.xml','docs/technology.xml','vibe.toml','docs/vibe/governance.toml','docs/vibe/macros.toml']; missing=[p for p in required if not Path(p).exists()]; assert not missing, missing"
phase-level.focus: Presence and coherence of the full VIBE planning surface expected by GRACE-compatible workflows.

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer real artifact parsing and deterministic file-level checks over synthetic mocks for planning surfaces.

Observability.logger: Stable document and trace markers inside XML, TOML, and Markdown artifacts.
Observability.redaction: Never store secrets, credentials, tokens, or runtime-only sensitive state inside canonical planning artifacts.

DeliveryShape.shape: Framework and bootstrap-design workspace, not an end-user application runtime.
DeliveryShape.notes: vibestart product semantics are defined as core and deep bootstrap profiles over one VIBE methodology.
